description: This source file contains utility functions for resolving extension directories, generating test plans, creating test shards, and merging plans for a project that manages extensions and their testing workflows. It imports various path and filesystem modules, as well as project-specific modules for path definitions and extension type identification.

methods.name: resolveExtensionTestPlan
methods.description: Generates a test plan for a specified extension directory, determining associated configurations, test files, and roots based on extension type and project structure.

methods.name: mergeTestPlans
methods.description: Combines multiple test plans into a single aggregated plan, grouping by configuration and collecting associated extension IDs, roots, and test file counts.

methods.name: resolveExtensionBatchPlan
methods.description: Creates an overall batch test plan by resolving individual extension test plans for a list of extension IDs.

methods.name: pickLeastLoadedShard
methods.description: Selects the shard with the fewest test files and plans to balance workload when distributing test plans.

methods.name: createExtensionTestShards
methods.description: Partitions extension test plans into a specified number of shards for parallel testing, balancing workload across shards.
